content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find it easier to stay focused on your writing when your phone is out of sight?
answer: Yes, but I think the benefit goes beyond avoiding notifications. Even an idle phone can create a subtle expectation that something more interesting might happen at any moment. That expectation competes with the patience writing requires, especially when a sentence becomes difficult to finish. Putting the phone out of sight removes the temptation to renegotiate your attention. Sometimes, uninterrupted writing begins not with greater discipline, but with fewer opportunities to abandon a thought.
